text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan Tambahan) (2016) 2017.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 Januari 2016.

Pengeluaran tambahan bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2016

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lima puluh enam juta enam ratus ribu

ringgit (RM56,600,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial bagi perbelanjaan tambahan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial

sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual bagi tahun 2016 yang tidak

diperuntukkan atau yang tidak diperuntukkan dengan sepenuhnya di bawah

Peraturan-Peraturan Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2016 [P.U. (A) 51/2016].

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain RM56,600,000

Jumlah RM 56,600,000

Dibuat 3 Ogos 2017

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXII]

DATO' SRI (DR) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLEMENTARY SUPPLY) (2016)

REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security

(Supplementary Supply) (2016) Regulations 2017.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 January 2016.

Additional issue for expenditure for the year 2016

2. A sum not exceeding fifty-six million six hundred thousand

ringgit (RM56,600,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security Fund for additional

expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security as specified in the

Schedule for the year 2016 which is not provided for or not fully provided for under the

Employees' Social Security (Supply) Regulations 2016 [P.U. (A) 51/2016].

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

 Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM56,600,000

Total RM 56,600,000

Made 3 August 2017

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXII]

DATO' SRI (DR) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
